uv_chalk.name: UV Inspection Chalk
uv_chalk.description: Conservatory-issue chalk that fluoresces under the studio lamp. Good for revealing oily residues.

tweezers.name: Specimen Tweezers
tweezers.description: Fine-point tweezers from the Orchid Wing. Pair with UV chalk to lift residue samples.

uv_kit.name: UV Sample Kit
uv_kit.description: Tweezers dusted with UV chalk — ready to lift kiln-brick residue from the pedestal base.

humidity_notes.name: Humidity Code Notes
humidity_notes.description: Numbers circled on Iris's log: day target, night target, and a 'panel override' scribble.

scratch_photo.name: Pedestal Scratch Sketch
scratch_photo.description: Your hasty sketch of an unusual curved scratch on the lock plate — not a standard pick.

tungsten_note.name: Tungsten Pick Note
tungsten_note.description: Rowan mentioned tungsten picks leave a shallow crescent scar. Your sketch matches.

bent_wire.name: Bent Studio Wire
bent_wire.description: A scrap of tungsten wire bent into a crude pick. Just the thing for a stubborn shed padlock.

pawn_slip.name: Pawn Slip
pawn_slip.description: Hollow Pawn & Loan — 'Grandfather's pocket watch, gold case.' Not an orchid. Theo's name on the line.

bid_copy.name: Bid Ledger Copy
bid_copy.description: Juliette Crane — private offer $80,000 for The Glass Orchid. Circled twice in angry pen.

anneal_recipe.name: Annealing Recipe Card
anneal_recipe.description: Liora's margin math: soak 480 → ramp 520 → hold 560. Oven keypad wants that sequence.

studio_keycard.name: Studio Keycard
studio_keycard.description: Released from the oven safe after the annealing sequence. Opens the hollow kiln brick latch.

crowbar.name: Service Crowbar
crowbar.description: Short crowbar from behind the night service door. Useful leverage on kiln brickwork.

badge_fragment.name: Badge Admin Fragment
badge_fragment.description: Celeste's half-password for the atrium badge terminal. Pair with the climate log timeline.

bequest_page.name: Reassembled Bequest
bequest_page.description: Liora's bequest: sculpture stays public. Private sale voids the gift. Juliette's pressure play looks uglier now.

glass_orchid.name: The Glass Orchid
glass_orchid.description: Recovered. Cool to the touch, still singing Liora's formula. Evidence and heirloom.

locker_digits.name: Locker Digits Note
locker_digits.description: From the seating chart cipher: JC-TH-RV → useful flavor, optional for Finn's sharper hint.
